{{Quote|If I get the ship working again, I'll drop you two off at Ponemah Terminal, but that's as far as I can go. Ponemah's still neutral territory.|Rey|<ref name="Novel">[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Force Awakens'' novelization]]</ref>}}
'''Ponemah Terminal''', also known simply as '''Ponemah''', was a remote [[desert]] [[planet]] located in [[the galaxy]]'s [[Outer Rim Territories]], near the planets [[Ogem]] and [[Jakku]] in the [[Mid Rim Territories|Mid Rim]]. It was located not too far from the edge of [[New Republic]] space, and so was postulated to be a good place to drop off [[Resistance]]-friendly passengers.

==Description==
Ponemah was entirely covered in [[desert]], making for a harsh environment. The [[planet]]'s south polar region, known as the [[Sea of Sand]], was the harshest region on the planet, containing electromagnetic storms and giant [[sand worm]]s. The planet's sand [[worm]]s could grow to more than ninety [[meter]]s in length, and were extremely dangerous. They were most common in the Sea of Sand, which, due to its extremely inhospitable environment, was generally avoided by visitors to the planet.<ref name="Lost Treasure" /> Ponemah Terminal was one of the end points of the [[Burke's Trailing]] [[smuggler]]'s [[hyperspace route]], which connected the world to the planet [[Jakku]].<ref name="Smuggler's Guide" />

==History==
===Clone Wars===
The ''[[Obrexta III]]'', a [[cruiser]] in service to the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]], crashed on the [[planet]] during the [[Clone Wars]], while carrying a [[clone trooper]] named [[Kix]], who had been frozen in stasis. Five [[Standard decade|decades]] later, the [[Starship|ship]] was discovered by several different groups of [[pirate]]s, including the [[Sidon Ithano|Crimson Corsair]] and [[Sidon Ithano's pirate crew|his crew]], in the Sea of Sand.<ref name="Lost Treasure" />

===Galactic Civil War===
The [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[space station]] [[Wrath (space station)|Wrath]] [[orbit]]ed Ponemah, although the planet was not visible due to the station's lack of windows. [[Grand Moff]] [[Randd]]<ref name="LS" /> of the [[Exterior]]<ref name="Life Debt">''[[Aftermath: Life Debt]]''</ref> and [[Captain]] [[Ciena Ree]] were both stationed there in the buildup to the [[Battle of Jakku]].<ref name="LS" />

===Cold War===
After leaving Jakku, Ponemah Terminal, a neutral world in the [[Cold War]] between the [[New Republic]] and [[First Order]], would have been the drop-off planet for [[Finn]] and [[BB-8]] after [[Rey Skywalker|Rey]] fixed the ''[[Millennium Falcon]]''. However, the ''Falcon''{{'s}} capture by its former [[captain]], [[Han Solo]], altered these plans, and the group never visited Ponemah.<ref name="Novel" /><ref name="Survival">''[[Rey's Survival Guide]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
According to the map in ''[[Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge: Traveler's Guide to Batuu]]'', as well as [[Star Wars Galaxy Map (poster)|''Star Wars'' Galaxy Map]], Ponemah Terminal is located near the [[moon]] of [[Endor]] in the grid square H-16,<ref name="Coordinates">''[[Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge: Traveler's Guide to Batuu]]'' places Ponemah in what [[Star Wars: The Force Awakens Beginner Game|''Star Wars: The Force Awakens'' Beginner Game]] identifies as grid square H-16 of the [[Standard Galactic Grid]].</ref> but the map inside [[2018]]'s ''[[Star Wars: Smuggler's Guide]]'' places Ponemah near [[Jakku]].<ref name="Smuggler's Guide" />
